strings: peak: round caps and joins as attributes on the path (Spectr)
presets: three stroked paths at their own opacity (Spectr)
lucide: stroke style declared once on the root, inherited by every shape
miter: an explicit miter limit, and a bevel join from an inline style
square: a cap from a group's inline style
length: pathLength and a dash offset on a solid stroke
faded: a fill-only shape's opacity, and an rgba fill under fill-opacity
shape-opacity: a fill and a stroke composite as one layer
paint-reference: a marker draws an arrowhead the lowering cannot
